Class AlienLifeSupport

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.AlienLifeSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AlienLifeSupport extends Component
Represents a specialized component which, if attached to the ship next to a cabin, ensures it can contain alien inhabitants.
